pyq_bad.why: suspect key: Lok Sabha limit in 2011 was Rs 40 lakh (70 lakh from 2014), not Rs 1 crore
suspect key: A (Goa 1999) is true; B is false (1998 trials were MP, Rajasthan, Delhi) -> 'Only B'
wrong topic: current affairs (President of India)
suspect key: ONOE bill amends Arts 83 and 172 (both options); key 356 is ambiguous

patterns: APPSC asks EVM/VVPAT 'firsts' (Goa 1999 whole-State, Noksen 2013 VVPAT), EVM capacity and committee-subject matching (Vohra, Indrajit Gupta, Goswami).
'Which is NOT on Centre-State relations' with Indrajit Gupta as the odd one out recurs (APPSC-G2 2025, UPPSC 2015).
Other PSCs test electoral-bond features (SBI, 15 days, 1% vote), expenditure limits and RPA disqualification on conviction.
PYQs are mostly direct one-fact or short two-statement items; app relies heavily on 3-4 statement items, case-law detail (ADR v ECI 45 days, 5% EVMs) and 2026 current affairs.
App covers RPA section numbers (77, 78, 81, 135B/C, 151A) at a depth no PYQ here reaches.
